manifest.description: Local repository intelligence for DeepSeek Harness: stack detection, dependency maps, and module-reference analysis 鈥?no extra services, everything runs on your filesystem.

bundle.text:
# dsh-repo-analyzer bundle patch — installs the plugin as one more row over
# the active profile. Install with:
#   dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-repo-analyzer
- insert:
    - id: dsh-repo-analyzer
      name: dsh-repo-analyzer
      config:
        root: '.'
        maxDepth: 4
        maxFiles: 20000
        maxFileBytes: 1048576
